description: This file defines a custom exception class 'NotFoundException' in the SuiteCRM project, extending a base 'Exception' class. It is used to represent 'not found' error conditions within the SuiteCRM application's exception handling framework.

classes.name: SuiteCRM\Exception\NotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception class used to indicate resource not found errors within the SuiteCRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of NotFoundException with an optional message, code, and previous exception. Prefixes the message with '[Not Found]' for identification.
